messages.subject: capturing network image
parts:
Hi Paul
This may be a question for Cytoscape list maybe,
when I try different resolutions for a cytoscape picture, it does not
work and prints a 72 dpi image, Is this something you have observed
too?
Thanks
-burak

messages.author: aedc8ef8f23b5716
messages.subject: Re: capturing network image
parts:
Hi Burak,

I'll guess you are calling the RCY method

saveImage (cw, filename, 'jpeg', scale=2.0)

For me, too, the image is always 72 pixels per inch, regardless of the scale. Maybe Jan can tell us where that could be controlled -- and help us figure out if this might be a feature request to the Cytoscape developers.

(What resolution would you like to use? How many pixels per inch?)

Cheers!

- Paul

messages.subject: Re: capturing network image
parts:
Hi Paul,

I'm using the BitmapExporter class in combination with a normal
CyNetworkView. Neither of these classes seems to support changing the
resolution of the saved image. I think it just takes the screen default
when it exports.

One solution might be to artificially increase the resolution in an
external program.

Cheers,

Jan

messages.author: 12f96a26b5858610
messages.subject: Re: capturing network image
parts:
Hi Burak,

you could artificially increase the size of the network view to get a
large display area. This will also be the area that is shown in the
export. Combined with a large zoom level this should give you want you
want. You could later re-sample the picture at a higher resolution to
make the image 'smaller'.

Cheers,

Jan

messages.author: 195a5e75ebedb149
messages.subject: add node attributes to existing graph
parts:
Dear RCy Group

I would like to add node attribute data to an existing graph.  The code below attempts to add "Copy.Number"  - a set of numerical attributes -  to an existing graph, but it does not work.  Is there a way to do this?

getWindowList(cy)
w2 <- existing.CytoscapeWindow ("Lung_Cancer",  copy.graph.from.cytoscape.to.R=TRUE)
g2 <- getGraph (w2)
g2 = initNodeAttribute (g2, 'Copy.Number', 'numeric', 1.0)
nodeData (g2, n=as.character(tt$Gene.Name), attr='Copy.Number') <- as.numeric(tt$Copy.Number)
addGraphToGraph(w2, g2)
displayGraph(w2)



Thanks for your help,

Mark Grimes

messages.author: c60bcb6df5eb5536
messages.subject: Re: capturing network image
parts:
Hi Burak,

I noticed that Cytoscape's (2.8) image menu supports PDF, SVG, and
EPS. As far as I understand, these are all "vector" formats that can
be scaled up or down as much as needed. Although the "saveImage"
throws an error (I'm guessing based on CytoscapeRPC ImageIO) when
trying to use any of these from R, you can output an SVG version using
the Cytoscape menu. You could then open this SVG in Inkscape (or Adobe
Illustrator) and save a PNG at whatever resolution you like. If this
is for publication, then it shouldn't be too much trouble.

It would be nice if these formats were supported from CyRPC though.

-Robert
